body: claimed: Codex (len) · 2026-11-23 21:58:16 UTC · branch mkinney:issue/3769-docs-0.26 · plan: document the five released-site gaps, test both branches, and open two draft PRs.

Decisions for #3769:

- Use the released tree for all product facts. Put the shipped post list on the Posting page. This keeps it near post selection.
- Distinguish posts in the picker from scripts loaded by file. List machine templates without claiming physical acceptance.
- Document outline text through MCP and the resulting app profile. The released UI has no outline-font dialog.
- Keep the existing STEP unit explanation. Link to it from the upgrade note.
- Keep the existing 2D Adaptive protection explanation. Add the missing operation coverage without a duplicate section.
- Change only site files, as instructed. This excludes docs/decisions/3769-docs-0.26.md. This comment records the choices instead.
- Keep the main PR separate from #3768. Its site fixes change other files. Report any baseline failures instead of including unrelated changes.

Dropped: a new UI workflow, changes to product code, Cargo builds, and a decision file outside site/.

Self-review for #3769:

- Posting hunk: replace the incomplete list with released scripts, controls, machine files, and native Agie job limits. Users can identify the correct post.
- Face hunk: explain protection controls and the material left unfaced. Users can apply the shipped option.
- Offset hunk: identify the released Inside/Outside path issue and link its reports. Users see the warning beside the option.
- Trace hunk: explain protected selections, split paths, and refusal. Users can preserve protected geometry.
- Engrave hunk: state the same supported protection behavior. Users do not need to infer it from Trace.
- Finish hunk: explain the protected height range, assembly clearance, and final refusal. Users know what the option checks.
- Upgrade hunk: state format 78, part-off regeneration, and the STEP unit question. Users can retain an older copy and regenerate cached paths.
- Outline text hunk: show the actual MCP arguments and app placement workflow. State the missing dialog and profile-generation limit.
- Test module: pin the five documentation gaps against the released inventory. This makes each omitted subject detectable.

Each hunk is needed for items 1-5. No product code changes. No generated programs change.
